issue_request: FHIR-13464 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3. It requested a way to represent no oral liquids and resolved to use excludeFoodModifier with an oral-liquid code such as SNOMED CT Dietary fluid, while updating the element description from only food exclusions to oral food or oral fluids.
initial_application: Historical commit 4fb140007ce4d98260abb203f8af627c8951210e applied GF#13464 with related NutritionOrder updates and changed the original spreadsheet definition for excludeFoodModifier to mention oral food or oral fluids. Later source migrations carried the resource into the active StructureDefinition XML lineage.
additional_context: The current build scope uses nutritionorder=NutritionOrder in source/fhir.ini. The active StructureDefinition says excludeFoodModifier is for specific oral food solid/liquid exclusions and binds to the shared Types of Edible Substances value set, which includes edible substances and water-related SNOMED CT content. Later issue FHIR-46700 refined the same element's long and short descriptions and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative current source already conveys the liquid-exclusion semantics requested by FHIR-13464, and adding another restatement would be redundant with later WG-approved wording.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 clarification for the same NutritionOrder.excludeFoodModifier descriptions; it confirms and refines the current solid/liquid exclusion wording already present on the combined branch.
